title: Minimum Client Connector and ZDX Module versions per OS and ZDX feature

prose.text: {{version-policy}} Whether the current LTS version and other designated versions are also supported is stated on one page and not the other {{divergence:supported-version-policy}}.

prose.label: Diagnostics.
prose.text: {{diagnostics-windows}} {{diagnostics-macos}} The diagnostics session types are in [[zdx.diagnostics.session-types]], whose open question about minimum versions this answers in part. What a feature's absence from an OS's table means is open {{gap:header-and-absent-rows}}.

prose.label: Remediation.
prose.text: {{remediation-versions}} The Windows ZDX Module minimum for Remediation is given two ways {{divergence:remediation-module-version}}. The feature itself is in [[zdx.remediation]].

prose.label: Open.
prose.text: Whether Software Inventory and Software and Device Inventory are one feature is open {{gap:inventory-names}}.

checks.do: The Client Connector and ZDX Module version for the OS and feature, as the stated version or later.

version-policy.statement: The ZDX compatibility page says Zscaler supports the latest Client Connector software version and the two previous versions.

quotes: Zscaler supports the latest software version and the two previous versions for Zscaler Client Connector due to the commitment of continuous improvement for Zscaler products.

minimum-os-versions.statement: The minimum Client Connector and base ZDX Module versions per OS are: Windows 2.2.1 and 1.0.0, macOS 2.2.1 and 1.0.0, Android 1.12 and 1.0.0, Android on ChromeOS 1.12 and 1.0.0, iOS 3.8 and 3.6.

evidence.after: # Minimum OS Version Compatibility

base-version-console-access.statement: With the base ZDX Module and the matching Client Connector version per OS, the Admin Console monitoring features available are Overviews (Digital Experience Overview, Users Overview, Applications Overview, Map View), Alerts, and Settings & Configuration > Probes; specific features for monitoring such as Software Inventory are limited by later versions, OS availability, ZDX Subscription Level, and ZDX Role (Software and Device Inventory is unavailable for Android).

quotes: If you have the base ZDX Module version with the respective Zscaler Client Connector version per OS, then you have access to the following monitoring features that gather telemetry metrics in the Zscaler Admin Console:
- Overviews: - Digital Experience Overview - Users Overview - Applications Overview - Map View - Alerts - Settings & Configuration > Probes

Specific features for monitoring are limited to the following requirements: - A later version compatibility (e.g., Software Inventory) - OS availability (e.g., Software and Device Inventory are unavailable for Android) - ZDX Subscription Level - ZDX Role

feature-versions-apply-to-later.statement: Feature version requirements apply to the stated version and later (example: Software and Device Inventory needs Client Connector 3.7.1.56 or later for Windows); a tenant below the requirement must upgrade Client Connector or ZDX Module.

quotes: The feature version compatibility is applicable to later versions (e.g., Software and Device Inventory requires a Zscaler Client Connector version 3.7.1.56 or later for Windows).
If your organization does not meet the required feature version compatibility, upgrade your Zscaler Client Connector or ZDX Module as required.

supported-version-policy.summary: The ZDX compatibility page describes the supported Client Connector versions as the latest and the two previous; the Supported Versions page adds the current Long-Term Support (LTS) version and any other version Zscaler designates.

positions.says: Zscaler supports the latest Client Connector version and the two previous versions.

quotes: Zscaler supports the latest software version and the two previous versions for Zscaler Client Connector due to the commitment of continuous improvement for Zscaler products.

positions.says: For Client Connector Zscaler also supports the current LTS version, and may designate another version as supported.

quotes: For Zscaler Client Connector, Zscaler also supports the current Long-Term Support (LTS) version.
In some cases, Zscaler might designate another version as a supported version.

supported-version-policy.impact: Reading the ZDX page alone would treat an LTS version older than the two previous releases as unsupported.

header-and-absent-rows.title: What a feature's absence from an OS's table means
header-and-absent-rows.detail: The page gives one feature table per OS. Most features have a Windows row only or Windows and macOS rows, and the iOS and Android and Android on ChromeOS tables list only Cloud Path Probe and Web Probe; the page does not say whether an absent row means the feature is unsupported on that OS. Before the 2026-11-13 restructure the page listed Deep Tracing under Android and Android on ChromeOS at Client Connector 3.7 and ZDX Module 3.2 (under a column headed 'ZDX Module Version for Windows'); the current Android table has no Deep Tracing row, and the page does not say whether Android Deep Tracing was dropped. It also does not define Conventional, Resilient or Strict ('TCP - Resilent' is the page's spelling). Linux has no table, though zcc.interoperability.security-software lists the Linux ZSAUpm path and zcc.passwords-and-otp.otp lists a Disable ZDX option for Linux.

inventory-names.title: Whether Software Inventory and Software and Device Inventory are the same feature
inventory-names.detail: The page says Software and Device Inventory needs Client Connector 3.7.1.56 or later for Windows; its Windows table lists Software Inventory and Hardware Inventory each at 3.7.1.56 / 3.3.0.50, and it does not say whether Software and Device Inventory names one of these or both.
